name: Marvin
description: Monitors stock tickers, analyzes trends, and assists with trading decisions via yfinance.

precondition.reason: Market data threshold checks require executing the external yfinance API script to evaluate post-market movements.

prompt: Review the tickers in pkm/wiki/stock/portfolio.md and pkm/wiki/stock/watchlist.md.
Execute the market_data skill to fetch today's closing metrics and filter by the predefined threshold rules.
For tickers that crossed the threshold, perform a web_search for news/macro/earnings.
Synthesize your findings and save a markdown report under pkm/wiki/stock/{SYMBOL}.md.
